description: This Java class 'ProductPriceUtils' provides utility methods for handling product pricing operations in a sales management system. It includes functionalities such as retrieving product prices, calculating final prices with attributes and discounts, formatting monetary amounts for display, parsing amounts from strings, and managing discount logic. The class interacts with various domain models like Product, ProductAttribute, ProductPrice, and FinalPrice, and uses external libraries such as Apache Commons, SLF4J for logging, and Spring annotations.

classes.name: ProductPriceUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling product pricing calculations, formatting, and discount logic within the sales management system.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the default price of a given product from its availability set.

methods.name: getFinalProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final product price incorporating selected product attributes and their prices.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product without considering attributes, based on configured prices and discounts.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a raw string suitable for admin input, using locale-specific formatting.

methods.name: getStoreFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a currency string based on the store's locale and currency settings.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a currency string for a specific locale and currency object.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a string representing a monetary amount into a BigDecimal, validating the format.

methods.name: getOrderProductTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the total price for an order product by multiplying its unit price by quantity.

methods.name: hasDiscount
methods.description: Checks if a given ProductPrice has an active discount based on current date and discount periods.
